title: Fractions
description:
Build a tiny fraction library around the struct provided.

| Function | Does |
|---|---|
| `Fraction reduce(Fraction f)` | returns the fraction in lowest terms: 6/8 becomes 3/4 |
| `Fraction add(Fraction a, Fraction b)` | a + b, reduced |
| `Fraction multiply(Fraction a, Fraction b)` | a × b, reduced |
| `double toDouble(Fraction f)` | the decimal value |

To reduce a fraction, divide top and bottom by their greatest common divisor. `std::gcd` in `<numeric>` computes it. Denominators in the tests are always positive.

Adding: a/b + c/d = (a·d + c·b) / (b·d).
hints: Write `reduce` first and test it. Then `add` and `multiply` each build the raw answer and pass it through `reduce` before returning.
